atomic_facts.fact: René Benko was convicted of insolvency fraud in October 2025.
The October 2025 conviction was handed down by the Landesgericht Innsbruck (Innsbruck State Court).
René Benko was sentenced to two years imprisonment for the October 2025 conviction.
Nathalie Benko is the wife of René Benko.
Nathalie Benko was acquitted in a criminal trial.
Nathalie Benko's acquittal occurred in the December 2025 trial at the Landesgericht Innsbruck.
Nathalie Benko was not convicted of any criminal offense in 2025.
Nathalie Benko was involved in legal proceedings related to the Signa Holding bankruptcy.
Those proceedings involving Nathalie Benko took place at the Landesgericht Innsbruck in December 2025.
